items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: He played with Bolton and Frankie Dewson.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was an old fellow. Very sensible fellow. Great man. Can't think of his name. Wasn't Brock? No. What?
Brock Mumford. Brock Mumford. He played with Bolton and Frankie Dewson. I don't know those guitar players.

No, I don't know this guitar player either because he was a very sensible fellow. He didn't drink and he didn't smoke, you see. And he tried to carry the band on straight. Well, I kept that place going for two summers. And after then I started playing music. Roy Palmer brought me a horn. And the first thing that I did, Roy brought the horn by there about eight o'clock that night. And it was brass. And the greatest thing that I wanted to see, that horn shine. So I just waited until the next day and brought me some…

items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Bunk started to play him when Eddie Bolden had a band.

ctx.x: Down near Clayborne and Dumaine, but it's an undertaking part. Yeah. Oh, one other question. Did you ever hear Bunk Johnson, did you ever hear him play?
Bunk Johnson? Why, Bunk, why, he started to play him. Bunk started to play him when Eddie Bolden had a band.
Yeah. Did you ever hear Bolden?
